pull.title: KIP-891: Multiversioning in Kafka Connect - Config and Validation Tests
pull.body:
This adds tests for
[KIP-891](https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/KAFKA/KIP-891%3A+Running+multiple+versions+of+Connector+plugins).
. This adds tests for connector config and validations with connector
versions. It has dependency on the actual KIP implementation PRs and
previous tests PRs and should be merged post
https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/17742 and
https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/18325

### Committer Checklist (excluded from commit message)
- [ ] Verify design and implementation
- [ ] Verify test coverage and CI build status
- [ ] Verify documentation (including upgrade notes)

Reviewers: majialong <majialoong@gmail.com>

commit.message: update validation logic for connector versions
add getter for all plugins for a class
Allow super to load class but do a version check
validate the version when loaded from parent correctly
bug in loadclass, should use fullname
add available version to exception and minor changes
Validation and recommendors for versioning transformations and predicates
Rename default version to latest version
Use current classloader when version is not present
Add a static loader swap method
add comment for servie loading bug and rename some methods
Add plugin version utils for parsing versions
Update abstract herder converter plugin fetching
Update version loading logic and add return delegating loader
Update default fetching and recommendor logic
add safe swap loader instead of static swaploader
Merge branch 'trunk' of https://github.com/apache/kafka into mvn-validation
Cleanup and changes post multiversioning merge
attempt to fix large diff in distributed herder
remove plugins.recommendor, use header converter defaults
add recommendor for invalid version, attempt to remove unwanted update
checkstyle fix and remove gitignore changes
Merge branch 'trunk' of https://github.com/apache/kafka into mvn-validation-transforms
fix bug in plugin versionloading and some tests
Validate plugin type while getting verison to avoid showing wrong default version
use version plugin loading exception in validation
Add transformation and predicate versioned test plugins
fix bugs and add loading test
add tests for different version ranges
separate out source and sink connector, add test for versioned converters
cached connectors should throw original exception

add service loader manifest for versioned source connector
add abstract herder to checkstyle ignore for class fan out complexity

issue.title: KAFKA-18988: Connect Multiversion Support (Updates to status and metrics)

repository.name: kafka
repository.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

issue.body:
The is one of a set of PRs for
[KIP-891](https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/KAFKA/KIP-891%3A+Running+multiple+versions+of+Connector+plugins).
The list of total PRs given below all build one the previous one in the
list. They can be reviewed individually, or if the complete set of
changes is preferrable, please refer to the last PR.

This is PR#5 and contains updates to show the version of the running
connector and task in the status endpoint. JMX task metrics have added
connector, task and converter version. New metric groups are introduced
for transformation.

1. https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/16984 - Plugins Loading
Isolation Changes
2. https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/17741 - Versioned Configs and
Validation for Connector and Converters
3. https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/17742 - Transformation and
Predicate Support
4. https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/17743 - Versioned Connector
Creation
5. https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/17988 - Updates to status and
metrics

### Committer Checklist (excluded from commit message)
- [ ] Verify design and implementation
- [ ] Verify test coverage and CI build status
- [ ] Verify documentation (including upgrade notes)
